skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the JGL Remodeling assistant. Planning a new kitchen, bathroom or finished basement? Tell me a bit about it and I'll help you get an estimate or book a time.

about.headline: You picture the room. We build it with the details you asked for.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same things from a remodel: a contractor who listens, a clear price before work starts, and a crew that finishes on schedule and leaves it neat and clean. Every job is run that way, from a tile floor to a full basement.

cards.title: Kitchens that need a refresh
cards.body: Kitchen remodels with the added touches you ask for, not a one-size-fits-all plan.

cards.title: Dated bathrooms
cards.body: Bathroom remodels, one or two at a time, finished on schedule.

cards.title: Basements that need finishing
cards.body: Main areas, half baths and closets that turn the lower level into real living space.

about.closing: Not sure where to start? Tell us about the room and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Getting a remodeler in St. Charles County to call back shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow estimates
points.body: You call contractor after contractor and nobody gets back to you.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough number that grows as soon as the walls are open.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: The bathroom stays torn out for weeks longer than anyone said.

points.title: Sloppy finishing
points.body: Uneven tile and trim that never quite gets finished.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a clear estimate.

solutions.headline: Straightforward remodeling built around clear communication.

services.title: Kitchens & bathrooms
services.body: Kitchen and bathroom remodels planned around what you want, with the details done properly.

services.title: Basement finishes
services.body: Finished basements with main areas, half baths and walk-in closets, ready to live in.

services.title: Tile, decks & custom carpentry
services.body: Ceramic tile, decks, painting, custom carpentry and foundation crack repairs.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Estimate it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your estimate
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give John a call.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We measure up, talk through what you want and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Neat, on-schedule work
steps.body: A crew that does what it says it will do, with the work area kept clean.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished room with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to do it right.

themes.title: We listen
themes.body: Your ideas and added touches built in, not ignored.

themes.title: Written estimates
themes.body: Scope and price in writing, so you can plan around it.

themes.title: Excellent craftsmen
themes.body: Neat, clean work and real pride in getting it perfect.

themes.title: On schedule
themes.body: Timely work, even when you make changes along the way.

realReviews.author: Brenda Firkus
realReviews.text: John and Jason did an amazing job on my kitchen remodel. I couldn’t be happier. They listened to my desires and did the added touches that I requested. They are kind, courteous, and professional. Beautiful kitchen and a happy homeowner!  Don’t hesitate to use them, I already am planning my bathroom remodel for 2023/2024!

realReviews.author: quinton young
realReviews.text: Hired JGL Remodeling to do 2 bathroom remodels. The did a fantastic job. they were very personable, timely, and more important, the did everything they said they would do. Great experience and are already planning to use them again.

realReviews.author: Lynn York
realReviews.text: We have had John and Jason tackle a large ceramic tile replace and install project as well as a small exterior project. We were VERY happy with the results. They are excellent craftsmen. They're work is neat and clean and they take great pride in making it look perfect. We highly recommend them.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your kitchen, bath or basement?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.
